interface Foo<in T> { m(x: T): void }
interface Wrapper<out T> { inner: Foo<T> }
declare const w: Wrapper<string>;
const w2: Wrapper<string | number> = w;
const w3: Wrapper<number> = w;
interface Box<in out T> { v: T }
const b: Box<string> = { v: "a" };
const b2: Box<string | number> = b;
type R<out T> = { get: () => T };
const r: R<"a"> = { get: () => "a" };
const r2: R<string> = r;
console.log(w2 === w, b2, r2.get());
